name: DataLab HQ
tagline: A data and analytics platform built for decision-ready dashboards — not another generic SaaS landing page.
description: DataLab HQ is a data and analytics platform for decision-ready dashboards — ingest business data, model metrics, and present operators with reporting they can act on without living in raw exports.

coverImage.alt: DataLab HQ — data and analytics platform for dashboards and reporting

problem: Teams collect data across tools but still make decisions from stale exports and one-off spreadsheets. Without a productized analytics layer, metrics stay fragmented and reporting becomes a recurring manual project.
approach: Build around the analytics workflow: bring data in, model the metrics that matter, and expose them through dashboards and reports. Keep the product focused on insight delivery rather than a thin marketing shell over a database.
solution: A data/analytics platform surface for exploring metrics, reviewing performance views, and turning operational data into readable dashboards — so the portfolio shows real analytics product thinking alongside SaaS ops tools.
features: Dashboard-first analytics experience for business metrics
Reporting views aimed at operators and managers
Data-oriented information architecture instead of brochure pages
Space for metric exploration and recurring insight workflows
Product framing that emphasizes pipelines and visualization
architecture: Analytics-oriented web product: data ingestion and metric modeling behind dashboard and report UIs. The emphasis is readable insight surfaces over generic CRUD — charts, aggregates, and operational KPIs as first-class product features.
